title: sedum album subsp. gypsicola
intro: Sedum album subsp. gypsicola, commonly known as Gypsum-leaved Stonecrop, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum album subsp. gypsicola are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to possess potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective properties, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmacological research.
